entries.behaviour: Run pnpm, never npm or yarn, to add or install packages.
Write a two-line summary and a test list; no long prose.
Prefix commits with feat, fix, chore, docs or refactor.

entries.content: Docs are written in British English.
entries.behaviour: Use British spelling such as colour and behaviour in docs and comments.

entries.content: The user works in the Europe/London time zone.
entries.behaviour: Give times in UK time when scheduling or reading timestamps.

entries.content: Mocks that pin call details broke on every refactor.
entries.behaviour: Test behaviour through the lowest stable seam, not mock call arguments.

entries.content: Authentication uses Clerk, chosen over Auth0 for its React components.
entries.behaviour: Build sign-in and user sessions with Clerk; do not add another auth library.

entries.content: The app deploys to Fly.io from the main branch.
entries.behaviour: Use fly deploy and the fly.toml in the repo root for releases.

entries.content: The database is Postgres through Drizzle ORM.
entries.behaviour: Write schema changes as Drizzle migrations; never edit the database by hand.

entries.content: The dev server runs on port 5175.
entries.behaviour: Open http://localhost:5175 to check the UI; kill a stale server on that port first.

entries.content: The e2e suite needs a fresh build; it runs the built main process.
entries.behaviour: Run the build before Playwright e2e tests after changing host code.

entries.content: UI lists paginate with Load more instead of infinite scroll.
entries.behaviour: Show the last 10 items with a Load more button and a search field.

entries.content: Secrets come from 1Password through op run.
entries.behaviour: Never write .env files; start commands with op run --env-file.
Run biome check to lint and format; do not add ESLint config.
